name: @spark-connect-js/example-node-tls-behind-proxy
description: Connect to Spark Connect over TLS via a Caddy reverse proxy

scripts.gen-cert: mkdir -p certs && openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -days 3650 -keyout certs/key.pem -out certs/cert.pem -subj '/CN=localhost' -addext 'subjectAltName=DNS:localhost,IP:127.0.0.1'
